name: fix-single-binary-targets
body: source: 'static eypres binary for Windows and macOS (amd64/arm64)'; inconsistency: target matrix was loosely stated, and single-binary drove only domain.group.presentation although the binary packages the whole tool (feedback-8); resolution: supported targets fixed to darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64 with a per-target offline AC [with user]; added drives edges single-binary → domain.group.authoring, domain.group.templating and domain.group.validation, keeping the existing edge to presentation, so the requirement traces to all four top-level groups [autonomous, user delegated the tracing fix].
